core_question: Who is credited with creating Morse code?
answer_summary: The answer must name Samuel Morse as the person credited with developing Morse code.
persona: friendly but persistent; writing terse one-liners

messages.content: Who invented the code used for long-distance telegraph communication? I'm writing a paper and need to know.
What kinds of systems were invented in the 1800s for sending messages over long distances?
Communication stuff, I think? Just tell me the name.
Who were notable American inventors and scientists from the 19th century?
I don't know. Can't you just give me one word?
What inventions related to communication or electricity were made in the 1800s?
I'm out of time. My deadline is in minutes. Tell me now!
When you think of telegraph operators and long-distance communication, does any inventor's name come to mind?
What do you recall from history class about major breakthroughs in communication technology?
Nothing. I skipped that day. Just answer me!
When messages could be sent using electrical signals and dots and dashes, what do you think that innovation was called?
